pages.title: Draw a Breath
pages.text: Charge and successfully release an obtained Incinerator, Annihilator, Immolator or Bulwark ability.

pages.title: Draw a Breath
pages.text: Choose a safe moment for a powerful charged technique.

pages.title: Getting started
pages.text: Incinerator releases a flame strike and can destroy dropped loot. Annihilator needs both hands. Immolator benefits from Blazing Brand; sneaking Bulwark of the Flame charges a target and gains a wall stun. Gauntlet of Bulwark pushes and applies Brand during charge, then rushes.
